title: Unusual login and unfamiliar IP response
text: When an employee account successfully logs in from an unfamiliar IP after several failed login attempts, analysts must investigate supporting event logs. For a sensitive account, recommend simulated session revocation after human approval. Do not assert compromise without enough evidence.

title: Privileged Finance account protection
text: Finance admin accounts are sensitive because of potential access to financial workflows. Analysts should prioritize unfamiliar login IP alerts for Finance accounts, review access logs and consider a password reset recommendation after approval. Business harm is potential unless verified.

title: Approval and incident audit
text: A containment recommendation must not execute before authorized human approval. Any simulated decision must record the incident identifier, analyst identity, decision, timestamp and outcome.

title: Evidence handling standard
text: Investigation summaries must distinguish observed login events from hypotheses. Cite event identifiers for evidence and policy identifiers for guidance. Missing evidence must be stated clearly.
